title: clue.social-publish.input v1
description: Versioned request to publish media to one social platform account. Implementation adapters (browser automation, official OAuth, or third-party backends) are out of band; callers only depend on this contract.

publish_id.description: Stable id for this publish job (also used as run folder name).

platform.description: Target network. channels = WeChat Channels (视频号). x = X/Twitter.

account_id.description: Local account handle; maps to a stored session/token vault entry for this platform.

content_kind.description: video = short/long video; note = multi-image post (e.g. 小红书图文); image = single image where supported.

body.description: Caption / description / note body. Platforms truncate independently.

media.description: Ordered media assets. For video, typically one file; for note, one or more images.

path.description: Absolute path or workspace-relative path to a local file. No '..' escape.

cover_path.description: Optional cover image path for video posts.

mode.description: immediate = publish as soon as the adapter finishes upload; scheduled = platform-native schedule when supported.

schedule_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime required when mode is scheduled. Timezone should be explicit (Z or offset).

visibility.description: Best-effort; ignored when the platform has no matching control.

dry_run.description: Validate and plan only; do not call the network adapter.

platform_options.description: Optional platform-specific knobs (playlist id, bilibili tid, collection name, etc.). Unknown keys may be rejected by a strict adapter.

workspace_id.description: Optional Polaristool workspace id. Path resolution uses Polaristool workspaceRoot, not a host literature workspace env.
